Billing

Tiers, rate limits, and billing account caps are all determined at the billing account level.

Gemini API billing plans include Prepay and Postpay.

Prepay is subject to overages during the approximately 10 minute billing pipeline latency.

Typically, your cost details are available within a day, but can sometimes take more than 24 hours.

Once you link a paid API key, you will be charged for AI Studio usage for that key.
